natural_body: SMB 40% discounts lifted acquisition and near-term revenue but cut retention 12%.

first.rationale: Activation messaging (memory_91) and shortened onboarding (memory_86) are both proven levers for week-one engagement and completion. Activation is down 6% QoQ and onboarding completion down 4%—both metrics these levers directly address. Unlike promotional pricing (memory_73 showed 12% retention cut), activation messaging targets the root engagement problem without discounting pressure. Referral incentives (memory_57) work only on established customers when activation is already struggling. Enterprise sales-assist (memory_44) is orthogonal to SMB activation crisis. By verifying the two highest-confidence, lowest-risk prior experiments, I can confirm effect sizes and timing, then deploy activation messaging immediately as the single highest-leverage move for sustainable recovery. This preserves budget for future iteration if engagement remains soft post-launch.
